content.description: Wire booking new/edit forms to load Customer, Port, and Container Type options from master data tables (mdm_customers, mdm_ports, mdm_container_types) instead of plain text inputs.
capabilities: Customer field: select dropdown from mdm_customers (name, shortName)
Origin/Destination Port: select dropdown from mdm_ports (name, unLocode)
Container Type: select dropdown from mdm_container_types (isoCode, description)
Options fetched server-side at render time (no client API calls)
Validation schema relaxed to accept DB ISO codes
acceptance_criteria: New booking form shows Customer as select with 6 options from DB
Origin/Destination Port shows 13 ports as 'Name (UNLOCODE)' options
Container Type shows 14 ISO-coded options from DB
Edit booking form pre-selects existing values correctly
containerType validation accepts any string up to 10 chars (not hardcoded enum)
edge_cases: No customers in DB — dropdown shows empty with 'Select...' placeholder
Existing booking has container type not in current DB — edit form shows blank selection
Tenant with no ports configured — port dropdown empty
error_handling: DB query failure — page render error caught by Next.js error boundary
